You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # separator rows: singleton runs of rows (isolated lines)
    runs=[]; i=0
    while i<h:
        j=i
        while j<h and g[j]==g[i]: j+=1
        runs.append((i,j-1,g[i])); i=j
    SRS=[r for r,a,_ in runs if a==1]
    fill=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Mset=set()
    lc={}
    for c in range(w):
        pv=[g[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in SRS]
        cc=Counter(pv).most_common(1)[0][0]
        lc[c]=cc
        if any(g[r][c]!=cc for r in SRS): Mset.add(c)
    Ms=sorted(Mset)
    O=[]
    for i in range(len(SRS)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(Ms)-1):
            L,R=Ms[j],Ms[j+1]
            vals=[g[SRS[i]][L],g[SRS[i+1]][L],g[SRS[i]][R],g[SRS[i+1]][R]]
            row.append(vals[0] if len(set(vals))==1 and vals[0]!=lc[L] else fill)
        O.append(row)
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=f(G[k+' input']); e=G[k+' output']
    print(k, p==e, p)

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # separator rows: dominant color covers >=60% of row
    SRS=[r for r in range(h) if Counter(g[r]).most_common(1)[0][1]>=w*0.6]
    Ms=sorted({c for r in SRS for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=Counter([g[rr][c] for rr in range(h) if rr not in SRS]).most_common(1)[0][0]})
    fill=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # map each marked col -> set of anomaly colors seen on separator rows (top line colors used)
    linecol={c:Counter([g[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in SRS]).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in Ms}
    # band colors: copy anomaly color(s) from top bounding separator row at that column, else fill

from collections import Counter
def analyze(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    runs=[]; i=0
    while i<h:
        j=i
        while j<h and g[j]==g[i]: j+=1
        runs.append((i,j,g[i])); i=j
    SRS=[r for r,a,b in runs if a==1 and Counter(b).most_common(1)[0][1]>=w*0.5]
    return SRS
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[k+' input']
    print(k,'SRS',analyze(g))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    # line color: dominant over pattern rows
    Sr=[r for r in range(h) if Counter(g[r]).most_common(1)[0][1]>=w*0.6]
    patrows=[r for r in range(h) if r not in Sr]
    lc=Counter([g[p][c] for p in patrows for c in range(w)]).most_common(2)[0][0]
    SRS=[]
    for r in Sr: SRS.append((r,Counter(g[r]).most_common(1)[0][0]))
    # marker colors per pair of adjacent sep rows sharing a column value: collect anomalies (col,val) with val != dom of that sep
    M=Counter()
    for i in range(len(SRS)-1):
        s0,c0=SRS[i]; s1,c1=SRS[i+1]
        for j in range(w):
            if g[SRS[i]][j]!=c0 and g[SRS[i+1]][j]!=c1: M[(SRS[i],SRS[i+1],j,g[SRS[i]][j])]+=1
    # output: one row per band; cols = distinct anomaly columns across bands? demo4 had 5 out-cols vs anom col count 3 pairs -> 5 cols... 
    return None
print(f('test'))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def info(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; e=G[k+' output']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    dom=[Counter(g[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in range(h)]
    SRS=[r for r in range(h) if dom[r]>=0.7*w and dom[r]<w]
    # pattern dominant color = most common overall
    oc=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print('==',k,'dims',h,w,'out',e,'sepdom',{r:dom[r] for r in SRS},'pattfill',oc)
    anoms=sorted({c for r in SRS for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=dom[r]})
    print('   anomalies:',[(c,g[SRS[0]][c]) for c in anoms])
info('Demo pair 1');info('Demo pair 2');info('Demo pair 3');info('Demo pair 4');info('Demo pair 5')

def analyze(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator rows: rows where one color dominates strongly
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if Counter(g[r]).most_common(1)[0][1]>=w*0.6]
    # separator cols: columns dominated by some color (not necessarily dom)
    sep_cols=[]
    for c in range(w):
        colv=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        m,count_=Counter(colv).most_common(1)[0]
        if count_>=h*0.6: sep_cols.append((c,m))
    print(k,'dom',dom,'sep_rows',sep_rows,'sep_cols',sep_cols[:12])
    return dom,sep_rows,sep_cols
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    analyze(k)

steps.input:
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    g=G[k+' input']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    scc=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n>=h*0.7 and v!=dom]
    sepc=scc[0] if scc else None
    srs=[r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==sepc)>=w*0.6]
    scs=[c for c in range(w) if sum(1 for x in [g[r][c] for r in range(h)] if x==sepc)>=h*0.6]
    inter=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in srs for c in scs]
    # per demo: how many anomalous intersections? 
    iso=sorted(set((r,c,v) for r,c,v in inter if v!=sepc))
    print('==',k,'rowlines',srs,'collines',scs,'n_anom_intersections',len(iso),iso[:10])
    print('   expected out shape', len(G[k+' output']), len(G[k+' output'][0]), G[k+' output'])

def info(k):

def solve(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepc=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n>=h*0.7 and v!=dom][0]
    srs=[r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==sepc)>=w*0.6]
    scs=[c for c in range(w) if sum(1 for x in [g[r][c] for r in range(h)] if x==sepc)>=h*0.6]
    inter=[[g[r][c] for c in scs] for r in srs]
    o=G[k+' output']
    Ri,Co=len(inter),len(inter[0]); Ro,Co_o=len(o),len(o[0])
    res=[]
    for di in range(-Ri,Ro+1):
        for dj in range(-Co,Co_o+1):
            ok=True
            for i in range(Ro):
                for j in range(Co_o):
                    blk=[inter[i+di+a][j+dj+b] for a in range(2) for b in range(2)]
                    vals=set(blk)
                    if vals<={sepc}: v=dom
                    elif len(vals)==1: v=next(iter(vals))
                    else: v=dom
                    if v!=o[i][j]: ok=False;break
                if not ok: break
            if ok: res.append((di,dj))
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(k, solve(k))

def bands_of(seps,n):
    return [list(range(s+1,e)) for s,e in zip(seps+[-1],[s for s,e in zip(seps,[0])+seps]+[n])] if False else None
# proper: between consecutive separators
def int_bands(seps,n):
    bs=[]; prev=None
    for s in seps+[n]:
        if prev is not None and s>prev+1: bs.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s
    return bs
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    g=G[k+' input']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # sep color: color forming full/partial lines; try each non-dom
    sepc=None
    for v,n in cnt.items():
        if v==dom: continue
        rs=sum(1 for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==v)>=w*0.5)
        cs=sum(1 for c in range(w) if sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==v)>=h*0.5)

    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepc=None
    for v,n in cnt.items():

        rs=sum(1 for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==v)>=w*0.6)
        cs=sum(1 for c in range(w) if sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==v)>=h*0.6)
        if rs+cs>=max(h,w)*0.3: sepc=v; break
    srs=[r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r] if x==sepc)>=w*0.6]
    scs=[c for c in range(w) if sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==sepc)>=h*0.6]
    R=int_bands(srs,h); C=int_bands(scs,w)
    print('===',k,'R=',R,'C=',C)
    # map each anomaly to which band intervals it bounds
    A=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] not in (dom,sepc):
                i = next(j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(R) if a<=r<b) if any(a<=r<b for a,b in R) else None

    for a in A: print(a)

def analyze(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    srs=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]!=dom for c in range(w))]
    scs=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]!=dom for r in range(h))]
    nbc=sorted([v for v in cnt if v not in (dom,) and v!=dom])  # placeholder
    pos={}
    other=[v for v in cnt if v!=dom]
    for v in other:
        cs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==v]
        pos.setdefault(v,[]).extend(cs)
    arows=sorted({r for cs in pos.values() for r,c in cs})
    acol=sorted({c for cs in pos.values() for r,c in cs})
    return dict(g=g,o=o,h=h,w=w,dom=dom,srs=srs,scs=scs,arows=arows,acol=acol,pos=pos,out=o)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:

import itertools
def clusters(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pos={}
    for v in cnt:
        if v==dom: continue
        pos.setdefault(v,[]).extend((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==v)
    return pos,dom
def bands(seps,n):
    return [list(range(s+1,e)) for s,e in zip([-1]+seps,seps+[n])]
preds={
 'strict': lambda rb,cb,r1,r2,c1,c2: min(rb)>r1 and max(rb)<r2 and min(cb)>c1 and max(cb)<c2,
 'loose': lambda rb,cb,r1,r2,c1,c2: min(rb)>=r1 and max(rb)<=r2 and min(cb)>=c1 and max(cb)<=c2,
 'overlap': lambda rb,cb,r1,r2,c1,c2: bool(set(rb)&set(range(r1,r2+1)) and set(cb)&set(range(c1,c2+1))),
 'corner_TL': lambda rb,cb,r1,r2,c1,c2: min(rb)>r1 and min(cb)>c1,  # touches TL corner side
}
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,7)]:
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pos,dom=clusters(g)
    srs=sorted({r for cs in pos.values() for r,c in cs})
    scs=sorted({c for cs in pos.values() for r,c in cs})
    # clusters as rectangles per color (min/max rows/cols among its cells)
    rects={col:(min(a for a,b in cs),max(a for a,b in cs),min(b for a,b in cs),max(b for a,b in cs)) for col,cs in pos.items()}
    Rb=bands(srs,h); Cb=bands(scs,w)
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(Rb)):
        for j in range(len(Cb)):
            hits={p: [c for c in rects if preds[p](Rb[i],Cb[j],*rects[c])] for p in preds}
            want=o[i][j]
            ok=[p for p,hit in hits.items() if hit and want in hit]
            res.append((k,i,j,'want',want,hits))
    print(k, len(res),'mismatches:',sum(1 for r_ in res if not any(True for _ in [False]) ) if False else '')
    bad=[r_ for r_ in res if not any(True for hit in [h] for h in [h]) ]
print('skip')

    scs=sorted({c for cs in pos.values() for _,c in cs})
    return dict(g=g,o=o,h=h,w=w,dom=dom,sec=sec,marks=marks,pos=pos,srs=srs,scs=scs,out=o)

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; lc=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    srow=[r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==lc)>=w//2]
    scol=[c for c in range(w) if sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==lc)>=h//2]
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(srow)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(scol)-1):
            cs=[g[srow[i]][scol[j]],g[srow[i]][scol[j+1]],g[srow[i+1]][scol[j]],g[srow[i+1]][scol[j+1]]]
            row.append(cs[0] if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=dom else dom)
        res.append(row)
    return res
allmatch=all(f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,7)])

def lattices(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: second most common that makes full lines
    lc=None
    for v,c in sorted(cnt.items()):
        if v==dom: continue
        fr=sum(1 for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c2]==v for c2 in range(w)))
        fc=sum(1 for c in range(w) if all(g[r2][c]==v for r2 in range(h)))
        if fr>=1 or fc>=1: lc=v; break
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==lc for c in range(w))]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==lc for r in range(h))]
    return dom,lc,sr,sc

for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,8)]+['Test input']:
    dom,lc,sr,sc=lattices(G[k+' input'])
    print(k,'dom',dom,'line',lc,'rows',sr,'cols',sc)
    marks=[v for v in G[k+' input'][0] if v not in (dom,lc)]
    # mark positions
    pos={}
    for v in set(G[k+' input'][0]):
        if v in (dom,lc): continue
        ps=[(r,c) for r in range(len(G[k+' input'])) for c in range(len(G[k+' input'][0])) if G[k+' input'][r][c]==v]
        pos[v]=ps
    for v,ps in pos.items(): print('  mark',v,ps)

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lc=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    R=[r for r in range(h) if not any(g[r][c]==dom for c in range(w))]
    C=[c for c in range(w) if not any(g[r][c]==dom for r in range(h))]
    blocks={}
    for a in range(len(R)-1):
        for b in range(len(C)-1):
            cs=[g[R[a]][C[b]],g[R[a]][C[b+1]],g[R[a+1]][C[b]],g[R[a+1]][C[b+1]]]
            if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0] not in (dom,lc):
                blocks[(a,b)]=cs[0]
    if not blocks: return []
    mr=min(b[0] for b in blocks); mc=min(b[1] for b in blocks)
    Hr=max(b[0] for b in blocks)-mr+1; Wd=max(b[1] for b in blocks)-mc+1
    out=[[dom]*Wd for _ in range(Hr)]
    for (a,b),v in blocks.items():
        out[a-mr][b-mc]=v
    return out
import json
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,8)]:
    ok=f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    print(k, ok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
